phrase: A chip maker's former boss may be plotting a quiet return to the company he once led. A top exam scorer confessed to cheating with AI and a hidden camera.
phraseAlternatives: A tech company's former leader is rumored to be angling for a return. In South Korea, an exam cheater used AI and a hidden camera to nearly ace a test.
A court let a price-fixing case against memory chip makers move forward. Meanwhile, a chip maker's former boss is already rumored to be plotting his return.
A new study found AI video energy use is growing fast and rarely disclosed. Parents paying top dollar for an AI-run school found half its students missed their math goals.
alt: A staggered two-panel scene: on the left, a person's head and shoulders peek above a cracked-open door set in a building, with a glowing gap at its edge; on the right, a seated person lowers their eyes while a small robot leans in to whisper near their ear beside a tiny glowing button on their collar.

brief.concept: A tech company's former leader peeks back through its half-open front door, hinting at a quiet return, while on the next page a top exam scorer is caught with a tiny AI robot whispering through a hidden camera.
brief.metaphor: A door cracking back open stands for a leader's quiet comeback; a whispering robot and a glowing hidden-camera button stand for an AI-assisted cheat caught red-handed.
